title: Complex Number Visualizer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: complex numbers
rectangular form
polar form
complex plane
magnitude and angle
electrical engineering
description: Interactive MicroSim that plots a complex number on the complex plane with its real part, imaginary part, magnitude vector and angle arc, shows the number in rectangular and polar form, and writes out the conversion calculation including the quadrant adjustment for the inverse tangent. A quiz mode hides the converted form for practice.

educational.topic: Complex Numbers for AC Circuit Analysis
learningObjectives: Calculate complex number conversions between rectangular and polar forms using the complex plane visualization
prerequisites: definition of j as the square root of -1

controls.label: Enter: Rectangular / Polar
controls.description: Switch the entry form while keeping the same number

controls.label: New Problem
controls.description: Random number in the current entry form with the converted form hidden

controls.label: Show Answer / Hide Answer
controls.description: Reveal or hide the converted form

assumptions: Angles are reported in degrees in the range -180 to 180

pedagogical.pattern: calculator with worked steps and quiz mode
pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Worked example with substituted values, then self-check practice problems
keyQuestions: Why does the inverse tangent need a quadrant adjustment when the real part is negative?
Which sides of the right triangle are a, b and r?
What are the signs of a and b in each quadrant?
commonMisconceptions: The calculator's inverse tangent always gives the correct angle
assessmentOpportunities: Convert randomly generated numbers by hand and check with Show Answer
